description: The subject convention v0's admission rule, header by header (evidencebook#116 design note section 4; Go checkSubjectEntryLocked, NewSubjectIDIndex, bookView.correlationOf), written by subject_admission_vectors_test.go (EB_WRITE_SUBJECT_VECTORS=1). Each case starts from an empty book. Each step is a record header the book is asked to admit, with a fixed record id: expect is ok (the record joins the log at that seq) or a refusal class (it does not, and the next step takes the same seq). subject_id_index is the index's root after the step, over the admitted records in log order (an index_root, window_open, window_close or book_close record is never indexed); checkpoint_commits is whether a checkpoint then, in a book that has never committed that index, commits it (once it holds a leaf). correlation lists, for each admitted record in log order, the identifier a correlation subject holds it under: the subject_id of the first subject_root it cites, else its correlation.exchange_id, else its subject_ref.
